description: Defines an interface for building responses and events related to 'ModifyFeature' commands in a live signals processing context, including factories for responses and events, and methods for creating specific response and event instances.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: Interface for building command responses and events for ModifyFeature commands, extending a step interface for response construction.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating command response objects such as created, modified, and error responses.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.EventFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating event objects triggered by ModifyFeature commands, such as created and modified events.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Creates a 'created' response for the ModifyFeature command.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Creates a 'modified' response for the ModifyFeature command.

methods.name: featureNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating the feature was not accessible.

methods.name: featureNotModifiableError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating the feature was not modifiable.
